proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the engine code/nameplate (stamped/label) and a wider full-engine photo.
Send a short video of the engine starting and running (cold start if possible).
Provide any diagnostic/OBD scan readout or mechanic’s test sheet showing no fault codes and knock check.
Provide mileage proof (if available) and close-ups that indicate whether it has been opened (sealant/fastener condition around key covers).
List included accessories/parts and send photos of each (alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, etc.).
response.reason: The seller’s insistence doesn’t replace missing evidence. With only photo 0 and no readable engine identity or diagnostic/start proof, the key claims can’t be verified, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
